reason: A DSH settings plugin that provides a searchable GitHub-backed marketplace for browsing, installing, updating, and uninstalling dsh-plugin packages.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置中提供插件商店，用于浏览、搜索、筛选并安装、更新或卸载 dsh-plugin 插件。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH settings plugin store for browsing, searching, filtering, installing, updating, and uninstalling dsh-plugin packages.

capabilities: Fetches plugin catalog data from the GitHub Search API
Displays searchable, filterable, and sortable plugin listings in a DSH settings panel
Installs plugins by executing pnpm add on the host
Updates and uninstalls local plugins by modifying package and bundle configuration
Writes catalog and installation metadata to disk
